eligibility: Stage III NSCLC; ECOG 0–1; thoracic radiation plan and suitability confirmed.
exclusions: Hypersensitivity to either medicine/excipients; pregnancy or breastfeeding.
monitoring: Baseline FBC, renal and liver profile. Isotope GFR preferred, otherwise verified GFR/CrCl estimate.
NCCP FBC weekly before treatment. Current etoposide SmPC additionally requires a blood count before each etoposide dose, including Days 2–5.
Renal and liver profile before each cycle; extra tests as clinically indicated.

Radiation oncology confirms planning and reviews respiratory, swallowing and skin toxicity. Imaging, tumour-marker testing and follow-up timing are individually prescribed; no universal interval is specified.
dose_modifications: Regimen-specific thresholds and exact gaps are encoded; etoposide count rows do not automatically modify or clear platinum.
Consultant discussion required for any dose modification. Product-information differences are explicit.

supportive_care.mapping_basis: Days1/8 Carboplatin moderate (AUC3, not AUC≥4) risk; Days2–5 etoposide low risk. Multiday/delayed-emesis plans require a reconciled prescription.

treatment_phases.label: Initial concurrent chemotherapy and thoracic radiotherapy
treatment_phases.duration_text: Two28-day cycles with concurrent radiotherapy; radiation oncology confirms radiation dose, fractions and exact dates.
treatment_phases.schedule_summary: Carboplatin AUC3 on Days 1 and 8; etoposide 50 mg/m² on Days 1–5; repeat every28 days, with concurrent thoracic radiotherapy. Two cycles in total.

administration.notes: 500 mL sodium chloride0.9% over60 minutes. Slow infusion; monitor blood pressure, hypersensitivity and infusion site. Current Fresenius Kabi SmPC says not to use in-line filters.
250 mL glucose5% over30 minutes. Calvert dose uses target AUC3 and verified GFR capped125 mL/min; do not calculate patient-specific mg from this reference.
